rows.statement: The paper studies (n-1)-dimensional sections of the unit cube.
Hensley conjectured that the volume is at most sqrt(2).
The text asks for the maximum volume, in terms of k and n, of the intersection of Qn with a k-dimensional subspace.
Ball’s theorem bounds the normalized section function for p=∞ by its value at a(2), equal to √2.
Eskenazis, Nayar and Tkocz extended the Ball-type maximal section result to l^n_p-balls for very large p.
Oleszkiewicz showed Ball’s result does not carry over to l^n_p-balls in the range 2<p<p0≈26.265.
In the regime where Ball’s result fails, the hyperplane section perpendicular to the main diagonal gives a counterexample for large dimensions n.
For the unit ball of l^n_p, the normalized volume of central hyperplane sections increases monotonically with p.
For l^n_p-balls, known section results transfer to projections by dualizing p to q=p′ and swapping minimal and maximal volume results.
For l^n_q-balls, determining extremal hyperplane projections is equivalent to finding best constants in a Khintchine-type inequality for random variables with an exponential density.
Identifying extremal hyperplane sections of l^n_p-balls is equivalent to finding best constants in a generalized Khintchine inequality.
For very large p, Ball’s result remains stable for l^n_p-balls; this phenomenon is called resilience of cubic sections.
本文证明借用 Ball 立方体切片结果中的做法，使用独立和矩的傅里叶变换表示。
Ball 的结果基于 Pólya 公式。
存在用 exp(−|r|^p) 的归一化傅里叶变换表示的 Pólya 公式在 A_{n,p} 中的类比。
Ball 使用 Pólya 公式 (2.1) 及其积分不等式。
The paper conjectures that the maximal hyperplane section of Bn p is either (a(2))⊥ or (a(n))⊥.
The article studies maximal hyperplane sections of the unit ball of lnp for p > 2.
Central hyperplane sections are sections of the cube Qn by hyperplanes containing 0, and their (n−1)-dimensional volume is a classical object of study.
Qn 的中心超平面截面是形如 Qn ∩ v⊥ 的截面。
The paper studies hyperplane projections of the unit ball of ℓ_p^n.
